subject: POC demo: reschedule to align with finance spend lock
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Ava Martin <ava.martin@edenhealth.com>, procurement@edenhealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: POC demo: proposed window ahead of CFO planning freeze

Hi Ava / procurement team —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, we'd like to schedule the 30‑minute POC demo and technical Q&A so your team can evaluate runtime economics before the CFO’s planning freeze next week. Proposed slots (all PDT):

- Tue Jul 29, 10:00–10:30
- Wed Jul 30, 14:00–14:30
- Thu Jul 31, 09:00–09:30

Quick notes:
- I’ve attached the draft SOW and a 30min agenda.
- We’ll include a short perf slice focused on latency and cost per 1k tokens.
- If the finance team needs a separate procurement call, we can loop Ben in.

Can you confirm which of the three slots works or propose alternatives?

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee | Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 415‑555‑0196
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW-draft-v1.pdf, POC-plan-30min-agenda.docx
From: Ava Martin <ava.martin@edenhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@edenhealth.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC demo: proposed window ahead of CFO planning freeze

Hi Soojin —

Appreciate the follow up. Our CFO is convening a planning lock on Fri (Jul 25) and the procurement team is running a short spend freeze until they complete headcount and capital allocations. Unfortunately that means we can’t make the Jul 29–31 windows for anything that would trigger procurement actions.

My calendar is open for a short demo, but I need to be explicit: we can do a purely technical overview for the engineering group (no pricing discussion), or we pause until after the lock so procurement can join.

If you can do a purely technical, no‑proc session, Wed Jul 30 at 14:00 works for our engineers (they’ll be internal only). Otherwise we’ll need to push to the week of Aug 18 when finance expects to reopen allocations.

Best,
Ava
Ava Martin | Head of Platform Engineering, EdenHealth
ava.martin@edenhealth.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 08:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC demo: proposed window ahead of CFO planning freeze

On Tue, 22 Jul 2025 at 11:07 AM Ava Martin <ava.martin@edenhealth.com> wrote:
> My calendar is open for a short demo, but I need to be explicit: we can do a purely technical overview for the engineering group (no pricing discussion), or we pause until after the lock so procurement can join.

Quick thoughts — thanks for the heads up, Ava. If the customer prefers a technical‑only run, we can deliver a tight 25‑minute demo focused on:

- architecture overview (5m)
- live inference latency/cost snapshot (10m)
- KV/prefix caching demo and short Q&A (10m)

Karthik, can you confirm we can run the perf slice without any pricing slides or SOW language? We should also redact pricing references from the deck and SOW before sending to the engineering attendees.

If they prefer to wait, I’d rather slide the demo to Aug 18–22 and use the extra time to prepare a procurement one‑pager. Either way, Marissa can coordinate calendar and materials.

—Ben
Ben Carter | Sr. Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ava Martin <ava.martin@edenhealth.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jul 2025 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC demo: proposed window ahead of CFO planning freeze

Hi all —

Thanks for the clarity, Ava. We can absolutely run a technical‑only session for your engineers on Wed Jul 30 at 14:00 PDT. We’ll do the following to respect the procurement freeze:

- Deliver only technical content (no pricing, no SOW language)
- Remove the SOW file from the invite and replace with a redacted POC agenda (attached).
- Record a short follow up packet for procurement that we’ll only send after your finance team reopens allocations (anticipated week of Aug 18).

Marissa — can you update the invite to include a Teams link and attach the redacted agenda instead of the SOW? I’ll plan the perf slice and make sure the demo runs on a deterministic model with fixed token budgets so we avoid any cost questions.

Ava — please confirm attendee list (engineers only). Otherwise we’ll hold the procurement/contract conversation until after the lock.

Thanks — looking forward to the session.
Karthik Iyer | Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
